notes: Valuation inputs use closing prices of 2026-10-02 (Friday; last close before 2026-10-04). Fiscal year ends last Sunday of January (FQ2'27 = 2026-04-27 to 2026-07-26). FQ4 values derived as 10-K FY minus 9M. TTM (FQ3'26-FQ2'27): OCF 134360 (FY26 102,718 + H1'27 74,421 - H1'26 42,779), purchases of PP&E and intangibles 7354, revenue 302969. Net cash = cash 22,443 + marketable debt securities 34,143 - debt 33,366 (1,000 ST + 32,366 LT; ~$24.9B issued in FQ2'27) at 2026-07-26; EXCLUDES marketable equity securities 42,783 and non-marketable securities 51,157 (strategic stakes). Including marketable equity would give ~66,000. Adjusted EPS caveat: from Q1 FY27 NVIDIA includes stock-based comp in non-GAAP and also excludes investment gains; FQ4'26 (1.59), FQ1'26 (0.78) and FQ2'26 (1.01) are company-recast figures, but FQ3'26 (1.30), FQ3'25 (0.81) and FQ4'25 (0.89) are only available on the old basis (overstated by ~$0.03-0.04/qtr vs new basis). TTM = 1.30+1.59+1.87+2.22 = 6.98; prior TTM = 0.81+0.89+0.78+1.01 = 3.49. Growth is therefore approximate (slightly understated). Post-quarter (not in balance sheet): 2026-08-17 8-K residual value guaranties for OpenAI-tenanted data-center leases capped at $105B (contingent, from 2028); 2026-09-02 agreement to acquire Hugging Face for ~$11.9B cash (close H1 2027). Founder-led: Jensen Huang co-founded NVIDIA in 1993 and is CEO (10-K).
